command: set -euo pipefail; ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 andreas@100.92.234.52 'set -e; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(whoami); systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service || true; systemctl --user show frankenstein-local-bridge.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus --no-pager || true; echo ENV_BEGIN; systemctl --user show frankenstein-local-bridge.service -p Environment --no-pager | sed -E "s/(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD)=[^ ]+/\1=REDACTED/g"; echo ENV_END; echo PROCS; pgrep -af local_bridge_daemon.py || true'
